notes: The shared image is oblique and its rows have different depths; simple screen width is not the native longitudinal length.

mountingReference.reason: The user identifies the leftmost mounted turret as ion. Photo3 has bow to image-right and stern to image-left, so the leftmost station is treated as aft/lowest native X.
mountingReference.uncertainty: Photo2 is a close crop without an independently visible bow/stern marker; station orientation is a cross-image inference, not a survey result.

interpretations: The user lists nine models. The175TT ION twin is the flattened IS-tank-like bowl; the normal175TT TL twin is angular and follows the new red technical detail reference.

The initial40x11x30 angular estimate and its globalphoto1 scale are explicitly superseded. Original corrected175TT was60x16.5x45m, larger than the40m ISD octuple in both plan dimensions. Compact front hardware reduces the current actual height to16.425m.
Photo2 mounted station pitch supplies the stronger angular calibration. Photo1 remains the source for model order, common ball diameter and the720/175 shape enlargement relationship.
The red technical drawing(photo5) is an authoring/detail reference only and supplies no metre or pixel scale.
Exhibition cylinders and the broad octagonal support below720TT twin are excluded from native turret envelopes.

angularAnchor.measurementRole: Mounted armored house plus front gun pod compared along the battery row; long barrels and the lower deck mounting pads are excluded.
angularAnchor.caveat: This is a projected longitudinal scale from an oblique, partly occluded ship view, not an exact reconstruction of all three native dimensions.
angularAnchor.userConstraint: 175TT TL twin and common175TT family must exceed the40m ISD octuple in plan; the old40x11x30 model was too small.

podWidthDesign.status: Latest user revision: all175 front mechanisms are scaled0.8. The triple shares the complete twin model and retains its outer tube pair, with only one center tube added. Original half-house-width limit remains an upper bound; actual compact twin supports fit well inside it.

ionDesign.case175Twin: Longitudinal flattened oval cast bowl with curved forward shoulders; narrow front mantlet advances relative to the angular TL twin. Current whole60×16.425×45m envelope; the original16.5m height is retained only as the720 scaling reference.
ionDesign.taperBeginsAt: Caller-owned visible barrel base so the exposed thick root narrows toward the muzzle.
ionDesign.status: Latest user correction: thick root and narrower tip. This supersedes the parallel1.5-radius tube interpretation. Numeric radius ratios are authored values and must avoid tube intersections in the existing40TT four-port layout.

roofConstruction.status: Explicit user correction. Earlier open-well interpretation is rejected. Internal recoil/equipment clearance remains reserved and is not free charging volume.

frontBaseRevision.source: User requested the angular twin-based triple with one center barrel and smaller175TT gun bases; later explicitly excluded spherical175TT bases.
frontBaseRevision.roomPolicy: Reserve conservative angular mechanism space and keep it excluded from charging cells. Do not credit new interface supports.720 and all ball geometry, mechanisms and rooms are preserved.
frontBaseRevision.status: A20percent authoring adjustment, not a new image-derived metre calibration. Actual geometry, contact, bounds and unchanged720 models are checked by generators and independent tests.
